The frontend owner describes the standard search form, accepted result copy and inherited navigation. The absent whole-new-design files do not require invention for this extension.

Reached for this ordinary document extension. The existing page calls for readable type, restrained rules, clear links and native controls; those are present. A quality card, decorative lettering, ornament, raster assets and authored motion have no authority in this scope. The review covers search design only, with metrics and the rest of T005 outside its decision.
